about.heading: Senior full-stack engineer specializing in Angular enterprise applications and scalable UI architecture.
paragraphs: I build and maintain enterprise Angular applications with a strong focus on reusable component libraries, design systems, and scalable front-end architecture. My work spans the full stack — Angular, TypeScript, Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Docker, and AWS.

I have shipped production software at The Home Depot and Truist Bank, including AI-integrated Angular experiences, enterprise design-language systems, and high-volume banking workflows. I also run startlearning.net to share what I learn about AI tools and automation.

experience.heading: Where I have worked and what I shipped.

items.title: Full Stack Software Engineer · The Home Depot
items.description: Building enterprise Angular applications and reusable UI component libraries across front-end, API, and database layers. Leading Angular modernization by upgrading legacy applications to current Angular releases. Creating Storybook component libraries with design tokens and contributing to an enterprise design language. Integrating AI-powered experiences into Angular workflows via RESTful APIs. Collaborating with UX/UI designers using Figma to deliver accessible, production-ready interfaces.

items.title: Full Stack Developer · Truist Bank
items.description: Developed enterprise digital banking applications in Angular supporting account dashboards, funds transfer, payment scheduling, and transaction history. Designed and implemented 20+ Spring Boot REST API endpoints, improving service response times by ~30%. Built event-driven workflows using Apache Kafka for payments, notifications, and fraud monitoring. Implemented OAuth2/JWT authentication and role-based authorization with Spring Security. Containerized applications with Docker and deployed to AWS Kubernetes environments. Maintained Jenkins and GitLab CI/CD pipelines.

items.title: Founder · startlearning.net
items.description: Building an educational platform to make AI accessible for beginners, covering prompt engineering, n8n automations, GPT, Claude, Gemini, and practical AI agent workflows.

items.title: Full Stack Software Engineer · Sanofi
items.description: Developed enterprise web applications across front-end, backend, API, and database layers. Built responsive user interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, and component-based front-end practices. Integrated UI applications with RESTful APIs and enterprise services. Delivered features following Agile/Scrum methodologies with business stakeholders, QA, and engineering teams.
